theme: quota plate KVFILEINC KVFILEDEL ENSURELINE gate counters

tests.name: gate
tests.cmd: gate under max=10 ok; over max=3 REQUIRE exit 2

tests.name: del
tests.cmd: del port → returns 7700; del none soft+REQUIRE

tests.name: ensure
tests.cmd: ensure feature_a present NEW=0; feature_c added

tests.name: ensure_exact
tests.cmd: ensure feature adds new line not substring match

tests.name: create_via_inc
tests.cmd: inc on missing path creates plate n=1

weaknesses.title: KVFILEINC on non-numeric value silently coerces (abc→1 after +1)
weaknesses.detail: retries=abc then INC yields retries=1 without OK=0. Corrupts plate counters; agents cannot detect bad seed values.

weaknesses.title: KVFILEINC/ENSURELINE create missing files — path typo becomes new plate
weaknesses.detail: Ghost path DEL soft-misses HIT=0; INC creates file. REQUIRE on inc never fires for missing path because create succeeds.

weaknesses.title: ENSURELINE is exact line; MATCHFILE ops are substring — dual semantics
weaknesses.detail: Good for allowlists: feature != feature_a. Agents mixing ENSURE with FINDFILELINE substring get different membership rules.
weaknesses.repro: ENSURE feature when feature_a present → NEW=1 append feature

weaknesses.title: KVINC bag vs KVFILEINC disk; ENSURELINE vs HASLINE+APPEND glue
weaknesses.detail: In-memory KVINC does not touch plate files. Dual-family trap continues for INC/DEL.

weaknesses.title: Empty key INC/DEL/ENSURE produce garbage rows or odd hits
weaknesses.detail: Empty key ops leave empty lines or =value-class artifacts. Plate hygiene not enforced.

weaknesses.title: WRITE trailing NL omit glues plate last line to next cat
weaknesses.detail: port=7700 glued to meta after first writes.

weaknesses.title: No dry-run or existing-only mode for INC create
weaknesses.detail: Cannot require pre-existing plate without agent EXIST check.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE env silently softens del/gate

workarounds: Validate counter values with NUM after LOOKUP before INC
SYS EXIST active before INC if create-on-miss unwanted
Use ENSURELINE for exact membership not FINDFILELINE substring
Reject empty key/line at agent layer
language_gaps: existing-only / no-create flag for KVFILEINC and ENSURELINE
ENSURELINE optional substring mode explicitly named if ever needed
issues_faced: Non-numeric INC coerce is critical plate footgun
Ghost INC creates file so REQUIRE cannot signal path miss
ENSURE exactness is a strength vs MATCH substring
